Entertainment.title: Reebok and ICECREAM Bring Back the Original Board Flip
Entertainment.text: SummaryReebok and ICECREAM have officially teamed up to re-release the Board Flip, a groundbreaking skate shoe initially launched in 2005 by Pharrell Williams and Billionaire Boys Club ICECREAMThe drop includes the return of the classic "Watermelon" colorway alongside the brand-new "Pink Lemonade" editionFollowing a BBC ICECREAM exclusive drop on May 1, the sneakers will see a wider global release on May 6, 2026 via ReebokHuge news for sneakerheads, skaters, and cultural archivists alike: the original luxury skate shoe is officially back. Reebok and ICECREAM have reunited to resurrect the Board Flip, a silhouette that marked a true turning point in the mainstream intersection of high fashion and skateboarding. Originally launched in 2005 as one of the earliest footwear expressions from creative visionaries Pharrell Williams and NIGO, the Board Flip famously laid the cultural groundwork for the luxury streetwear crossovers dominating the runway today.A key piece of early 2000s footwear history, the Board Flip quickly established itself as a standout within skate culture, becoming famous for its bold, confection-inspired designs.The green and pink "Watermelon" colorway serves as a direct, nostalgic nod to the brand's archive, while the pink and red "Pink Lemonade" pushes the story forward with a fresh expression that refuses to compromise the original design language. Make no mistake—despite its luxury pedigree, this shoe was created to be skated. Both models feature an injection EVA midsole with painted grooves, a durable rubber outsole equipped with a protective toe wrap, and alternate lace options to customize the look."In their own way, the Board Flip holds a distinct place in skate shoe history," shared James West of ICECREAM. "When the Board Flips came out, they were truly something unique, visually and culturally. Part neck-breaker, part head-scratcher—it's a shoe that even today people stop you on the street to talk about. They were the first of their kind, and as a fan who owned a pair when they originally came out 20 years ago, it's been really special to see them get the re-release they deserve."The highly anticipated revival officially kicked off with a BBC ICECREAM exclusive release, available now. For those who missed the initial drop, the Reebok x ICECREAM Board Flip collection is gearing up for its global launch on May 6 at 10 a.m. EST at Reebok.Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

Entertainment.title: Sir Jackie Stewart  Fronts the Formula 1 x NAHMIAS Campaign Ahead of the Miami Grand Prix
Entertainment.text: SummaryFormula 1® has officially partnered with LA-based premium clothing brand NAHMIAS for a brand-new lifestyle apparel collectionThe capsule features moto jackets, technical track sets, hoodies, and graphic tees that blend modern streetwear with classic racing uniformsThe collection debuted on May 1, coinciding with the highly anticipated Miami Grand Prix 2026 where ans can purchase the gear online or at an exclusive weekend-long pop-up experience located in the Miami Design DistrictAs Formula 1 continues to cement its status as a global lifestyle and cultural powerhouse, the premier motorsport organization has teamed up with Los Angeles-based label NAHMIAS for a brand-new apparel collection. Unveiled just in time for the F1 Miami Grand Prix 2026, the collaboration perfectly marries the high-octane energy of the racetrack with refined, contemporary streetwear, giving fans a fresh way to connect with the sport off the grid.Founded in 2018 by self-taught designer Doni Nahmias, the brand is traditionally rooted in California's surf, skate, and music culture. For this special capsule, NAHMIAS shifted gears, drawing heavy inspiration from the precision and intention of traditional racing uniforms. "We wanted to take that feeling and reinterpret it through the NAHMIAS lens to make something that feels real, elevated, and connected to modern fashion," the founder and Creative Director explained.The resulting collection is anchored by standout pieces like moto jackets adorned with bold insignia and technical track sets meticulously designed to mirror the look of authentic driver suits, as seen in the campaign fronted by Sir Jackie Stewart, former British racing driver. Balancing out the high-performance aesthetics, the capsule also includes more relaxed everyday staples like hoodies, fleeces, and tees. The garments are unified by co-branded Formula 1 and NAHMIAS graphics, alongside subtle nods to the label's recurring "Miracle Academy" motif.The NAHMIAS x Formula 1 collection officially dropped on May 1 and is available globally via the official F1 Store and NAHMIAS websites. Fans in town for the race can also shop the line—including an exclusive, limited Miami capsule—at a dedicated pop-up located in the Miami Design District running through May 4. Looking ahead, the two brands plan to continue their partnership with exclusive drops tied to other key global race destinations throughout the current season.Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

Entertainment.title: Isaiah Rashad's Return, North West's Debut: Everything We Loved in Music This Week
Entertainment.text: All of the biggest music headlines in one place and playlist. Updated live throughout the week.Action Bronson’s Wheel of Fortune Album AnnouncementAfter announcing his new album Planet Frog via socials last week, Action Bronson took the album announcement to another level – with the help of Ryan Seacrest and Vanna White.Stone Island Brings Dave's Personal Archive to New York CityAfter debuting its Selected Works: Archival Pieces From The Collection Of Dave 2016 – 2026 exhibition in London for the start of Dave's The Boy Who Played The Harp Tour, Stone Island is bringing the installation to New York City for the final stops of the run. Encased in a freestanding Plexiglass structure, the exhibit spotlights the custom on-stage pieces Stone Island created for the tour, as well as personal pieces from the rapper's closet. Stop by the Stone Island Store in SoHo through the end of the weekend to see it. Read the full story here.Kenny Mason Fires Up BULLDAWG With FearDorian-Produced Focus Track, "BOUNCE WIT ME"Yet another Summer 2026 hip hop drop we're highly anticipating. Kenny Mason's third studio album BULLDAWG is just under two weeks away now – unconventionally, the project will drop on a Tuesday – and the alternative-inspired rapper has just presented the project's lead single. Dubbed "BOUNCE WIT ME," the cut continues to establish the rapper's inability to be boxed into just one sound, equipped with production from FearDorian. BULLDAWG drops on May 12th.Edward Skeletrix’s New Album Features MOWALOLA and XXXTentacionRounding out at a lengthy 26 tracks bolstered by a wide range of featured artists is Edward Skeletrix’s third studio album, Body of Work. Preceded by a handful of solo singles, the just-under-an-hour-long project revels in an expansive collection of contributors. MOWALOLA contributes to “Art Is Sucking The Life Out Of Me Ok” and North West on “Let’s Have Some Fun.” Having produced a lot for XXXTentacion under his Cight producer alias, it’s no surprise a posthumous X track finds its way onto the final tracklist as well.After Her Brent Faiyaz Collab, Ama Ponders "So…"Following up on her recent collaboration with Brent Faiyaz, Ama has dropped another new single ahead of her summer run of shows as Ella Mai’s supporting act. The new single is called “So…” and hears Ama singing from the male’s POV, reflecting on the downfall of a relationship from his eyes. Ama’s sister, Mahalia, assists with the music video direction.PlaqueBoyMax Expands His Scope on Crash DummyMarking PlaqueBoyMax's first project of 2026 is Crash Dummy. The six-track EP hears the streamer expand his sonic scope a bit, pivoting into different lanes of production than on projects past.LUCKI Delivers a Dr*gs R Bad Prelude, Daysb4bad*Earlier this week, LUCKI took to socials to pose the question of a potential EP dubbed Daysb4bad*. The next day, he dropped the cover art. Today, the EP is here, and features "BAD Influence Freestyle 2 (FOR THE LOVE)," "BAD Influence 2" – his remix of Future's "MADE MY H*E FAINT" – and a Lil Yachty assist on "Sex Mula / Pete." Drugs R Bad is still set to drop on May 15.Ariana Grande Announces Eighth Studio Album, petalEver since Ariana Grande started sharing photos of herself in the studio on Instagram, fans knew that she was up to something – and we could only hope it wasn’t just another R.E.M. Beauty drop. Earlier this week, the songstress confirmed that it’s far from a product drop, and her eighth studio album, petal, is en route for Summer 2026. Described in a press release as “something that is full of life and growing through the cracks of something cold and hard and challenging,” petal is due out on July 31.Durand Bernarr’s New Album Features Big Sean, BJ The Chicago Kid, James Fauntleroy, Khalid, and Vic MensaFor the first release since his Grammy win for Best Progressive R&B Album, Durand Bernarr has done it again. On BERNARR, he gathers a lineup of R&B greats for lyrical and production contributions. Big Sean, BJ The Chicago Kid, James Fauntleroy, Khalid, and Vic Mensa all assist throughout the tracklist, along with songwriting legend Sevyn Streeter. Production comes from a rolodex of hip hip and R&B stars and up-and-comers, ranging from Raphael Saadiq to Miguel to Leven Kali.Sagan Lockhart Moved Into Shangri-La With The Alchemist and Freddie Gibbs for Alfredo 2. He Made a Film. And Told Us About It.Sagan Lockhart just may as well have been the third collaborator on Alfredo 2. The photographer moved into Rick Rubin’s Shangri-La studio in Southern California with Freddie Gibbs and The Alchemist for the recording sessions, aiming to capture as much footage of the process as possible. Lockhart sat down with us to share more about Shangri-La, which marks his debut film, and why he views it as more than just a behind-the-scenes look at the album creation, but rather rooted in the theme of “boundless creativity” at work. Read the full story here.North West Drops Debut EPNorth West's formal introduction as a solo musician has materialized. N0rth4evr spans six high-octane tracks, hearing West experiment with different lanes of rage rap and begin to find her sound.Isaiah Rashad Returns With an Instant Classic: IT'S BEEN AWFUL Is HereThe moment we've all been waiting for. Isaiah Rashad has lifted the veil on his fourth studio album – and first in five years – IT'S BEEN AWFUL. The 16-track offering was worth every minute of the wait. Features come from SZA, Dominic Fike, and Julian Sintonia, a TDE affiliate who also contributed ample production to the project as well. Read more here.Our Don Toliver Cover Story: "Don Toliver Has Tunnel Vision"This week, we unveiled Don Toliver as our third and final cover star for Hypebeast Magazine #37: The Architects Issue. Read the full story here.Mariah The Scientist Hops on Chxrry's "Bottles & Lights"The ultimate hot girl summer anthem, brought to you by none other than Chxrry and Mariah the Scientist.JPEGMAFIA Is Going on Tour With redveil and matt proxyPeggy pulled out all the stops for the album announcement, also revealing that he's hitting the road this summer on The Experimental Rap Tour. The 20-date North American run kicks off on September 22 in Spokane, Washington, and comes equipped with support from seasoned collaborator redveil and matt proxy.duendita’s existential thottie Is Overly Relatable10K’s duendita has delivered on just what might be her most relatable release yet. Billed as existential thottie, the songstress’ latest LP was written and produced between New York City and Berlin, and makes reference to moments such as: “breakups, crying in the club, emotional pain that never leaves, really hot and safe sex, birth control, fights in my hetero ass situationship, my time navigating the state mental health system… and ending with a promise that I will give healing my all.”Lelo Announces Mastiff EPOn the heels of last week's “Yoppenheimer” remix with Joey Bada$$, Lelo is in the lab once again. The Detroit rapper revealed that he’s got an EP coming out on May 5th, entitled Mastiff. A tracklist has yet to be revealed.North West’s Merch Capsule Spans the Entire Color SpectrumAhead of N0rth4evr’s drop, North lifted the veil on the EP’s accompanying merch suite, which spans the full range of hues. Including apparel, accessories, and vinyl, the drop’s hoodies and tees feature the cover art and tracklist, the lettering landing in shades of blue, pink, purple, red, yellow, green, and white. Vinyls take a similar color palette, while the punk-inspired accessories – like a key necklace and studded wrist cuff – take to an all-black colorway.The First Single From Experimental Rap Has LandedDubbed "babygirl," Peggy was quick to drop off the lead single from his imminent new project. The high-octane cut is a classic JPEG offering, fusing rap, rock, and punk, and paired with a cinematic music video.Little Simz Is Dropping an EP Next WeekLittle Simz is staying booked and busy. Less than a year off her latest longform opus, Lotus, and fresh off a packed few months of fashion projects, the UK rapper has announced a new EP set to drop in just eight days. Due out May 8th is Simz's SUGAR GIRL , her first formal project of 2026. Other details – like a tracklist, features, or cover art – are still under wraps.JPEGMAFIA Announces Experimental Rap AlbumWe're so back – Peggy is dropping experimental rap. Or should we say, Experimental Rap, as it's actually the title of his next studio album. Described by a press release as "both a display of power and a gauntlet thrown to the industry," Experimental Rap marks JPEGMAFIA's first studio album since 2024's I Lay Down My Life For You. "The era-defining magnum opus is a masterclass in left-field innovation, blending rap, punk, rock, industrial and gospel music with his signature 'no-rules” production and sharp lyricism," continues the press release. Expect Experimental Rap to drop everywhere on May 21.Jadakiss Flexes Air Jordan 3 WMNS "Orange Citrus" CourtsidePerfect for the Knicks. Isaiah Rashad Ramps Up Final Stages of IT'S BEEN AWFUL RolloutWe're in the final hours of Isaiah Rashad's IT'S BEEN AWFUL album rollout, with just a few hours left until the rapper's third studio project drops on streaming. Zay has stayed busy this week, though, having shared both "EPISODE 3" of his DJ Sonny Roshi TV series, along with a new freestyle that he delivered due to the third episode's initial delay in dropping.Max B Is Headlining MIKE’s Young World Festival – Along With MIKE HimselfAfter its abrupt cancellation last year, MIKE’s completely free, all-ages Young World Festival is returning to Brooklyn’s Herbert Von King Park on July 11, and this week, the two headlining acts were revealed: Max B and MIKE. New York’s Old Guard and New Guard take the stage among a soon-to-be-revealed lineup of other acts, including the stage debut of MIKE’s Band of the Century group that he performed with for his Tiny Desk Concert.Daniela Lalita Returns with Mura Masa Collab Cut and Self-Directed VideoFor the first time in four years, Daniela Lalita has dropped new music. The Peruvian, NYC-based musician has presented her first sonic offering since the release of her Trececerotres LP in 2022, returning in full effect with “Tiroteo,” complemented by a Mura Masa contribution and a self-directed video. Lalita’s main source of inspiration? Caterpillars. “I took inspiration from the way caterpillars liquefy inside their cocoon, turning into a nutrient-rich soup through digestive enzymes that break down their own tissue to rebuild into an entirely different insect,” she said in a press release. Iconic.Vince Staples’ Official Album AnnouncementAfter dropping off “Blackberry Marmalade” onto DSPs, Staples responded to the “CRYBABY” internet discourse – confirming that the red baseball hat in the music video did, in fact, confirm his next studio album and its release date. In the words of Staples himself, CRY BABY is confirmed to drop everywhere on June 5.Also, in the words of Vince himself: "As the world burns, I have decided to release this album. Thanks for listening."​​ Read more here.Edward Skeletrix and North West’s “Let’s Have Fun” Video Features our Favorite Underground CameosNorth has really stayed busy this week, showing out as a featured artist on one of the lead singles lifted from Edward Skeletrix’s new album, Body of Work. The video though is what takes the cake for this one, featuring a compilation of cameos from our favorite underground artists, including Sophia Stel, Feng, Baby Osama, and jackzebra.North West’s Debut EP Loading…North West has been serious about getting into her music bag. After stacking a selection of solid co-signs and production collaborations from the entire hip-hop spectrum – ranging from Ice Spice to Che, and FKA Twigs to skaiwater  –West is ready to make her first longform move. With her first solo single, “PIERCING ON MY HAND,” almost three months old now, the 12-year-old is taking it to the next level with her first-ever EP. Entitled N0rth4evr, the project is slated to drop this Friday, May 1, and spans six new tracks – “PIERCING ON MY HAND” not included. West produced all of it herself.The Styling In Lady Gaga and Doechii’s “Runway” Video Is Some of the Best We’ve Ever SeenIt was only right that two of the best-dressed musicians of the modern era handle the lead single for The Devil Wears Prada 2. Doechii and Lady Gaga’s “Runway” delivered on every single expectation – sonically alone. Now, the visual is here, and it only makes us love the track even more, in which the duo runs through countless designer outfits.Kith’s $1,600 Fender GuitarUnder its Kith Records creative umbrella, Kith presented the latest installation in its partnership with Fender: a custom Limited Player Stratocaster. The guitar runs for $1,600 USD. Read the full story here.Vince Staples Readies ReturnAbout two weeks back, Vince Staples sent out an email blast to fans updating them on his new private Discord server, creating the channel as a way to “improve the fan experience.” He didn’t share too much else in that initial message, aside from the ominous: “Stay tuned, because there will be both hijinks and shenanigans…. I will be back sooner than you think.”And indeed he was. Over the weekend, the rapper took to Instagram to share his first-ever studio single since he dropped Dark Times in May of 2024. Uploaded to streaming earlier this week, “Blackberry Marmalade” harkens back to Staples’ old sound, leaning into a guitar-heavy beat, and premiered alongside a striking Bradley J. Calder-co-directed music video.Fans clocked a “CRYBABY” red cap in the visual – resting on Staples’ car dashboard for all of thirty seconds at the start of the video – with “June 5th” etched on the side.Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

Entertainment.title: Cadillac Formula 1 Team and Nike Debut an Ultra-Rare "Miami Grand Prix" Dunk Low
Entertainment.text: SUMMARYNike crafts an ultra-limited 2-of-2 Dunk Low to celebrate Cadillac Formula 1 Team’s inaugural home raceThe design mirrors the team’s Miami Grand Prix livery featuring a "Stars and Stripes" motif in signature black and whiteExclusive pairs were gifted solely to team owners Dan and Cassidy Towriss with no plans for a public retail dropThe Cadillac Formula 1 Team x Nike custom Dunk Low is the ultimate manifestation of "Friends & Family" exclusivity, surfacing just in time for the 2026 Miami Grand Prix. Created to mark the team's historic first race on home soil, the collaboration yields only two pairs in existence, cementing a physical artifact for the dawn of a new American era in Formula 1.Revealed alongside the team’s official Miami GP livery, this Nike custom acts as a footwear extension of the race car’s visual identity. The aesthetic is anchored in Cadillac’s high-contrast black and white color palette, providing a sharp backdrop for a patriotically charged "Stars and Stripes" motif. Most notably, the design incorporates 50 stars across the pair — one for each American state — honoring the team’s domestic roots.Beyond the colorway, the shoes serve as a historical record for the program. The official date that the Cadillac Formula 1 Team was formally established as an F1 entrant is pressed directly into the material, ensuring the milestone is literally embedded in the craft. While the silhouette serves as a masterclass in custom storytelling, it remains strictly off-limits to the public. Gifted exclusively to team owners Dan and Cassidy Towriss, these will likely remain behind glass or on the feet of the paddock’s inner circle, making them one of the rarest Nike motorsport specimens in recent memory.Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

Economy & Markets.title: Armani Group Reports 2.8% Sales Drop in 2025 Amid Broader Luxury Slowdown
Economy & Markets.text: SummaryThe Armani Group reported a 2.8% decrease in 2025 full-year revenue to €2.19 billion EUR amid a global luxury slowdown, but strict cost management still resulted in a 2% increase in operating profit (€52.6 million EUR)These financial results are the first full-year figures released by the iconic Italian fashion house since the passing of its visionary founder, Giorgio Armani, in late 2025Acknowledging a structural shift in consumer approaches to luxury, the company confirmed that plans to sell a 15% stake remain active, with industry giants like LVMH, L'Oréal, and EssilorLuxottica reportedly showing interestThe Armani Group has released its highly anticipated financial results for 2025, navigating a complex transitional period for both the legendary brand and the broader luxury sector. The Italian fashion house reported a 2.8% drop in full-year revenue, citing macroeconomic headwinds and a sluggish global demand for high-end fashion. Notably, the report marks the first full-year financial figures disclosed by the company since the passing of its visionary founder, Giorgio Armani, in September 2025.For the 2025 fiscal year, the Armani Group's consolidated net revenue reached €2.19 billion EUR (approximately $2.57 billion USD). When factoring in direct licensee sales, the brand's total turnover achieved €4 billion EUR. The 2.8% revenue dip was largely attributed to a weak performance across the wholesale channel and ongoing adjustments within the luxury market, especially concerning the more accessible segments and a slowdown in Asia (excluding Japan).Despite the top-line decline, the privately held company demonstrated strong financial resilience. Thanks to strict cost management and a pragmatic operational approach, earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation, and amortization (EBITDA) rose by 3.2% year-over-year to €152.7 million EUR. Operating profit also saw a steady 2% increase, totaling €52.6 million EUR.Addressing the shifting landscape, Armani Group CEO Giuseppe Marsocci offered a cautious outlook on the industry's future. "We face a possible structural change in the approach to luxury and fashion by current and potential consumers, which must be taken into account," Marsocci stated. The executive also confirmed that the highly publicized strategy to sell a 15% stake in the company remains active. While formal talks have not yet begun, there is reportedly strong market interest from industry giants such as LVMH, L'Oréal, and EssilorLuxottica.As the company moves through the early months of 2026 with trends remaining in line with the previous year, the Armani Group is prioritizing long-term stability over short-term sales inflation. Backed by solid profitability and a steadfast commitment to continuity, the brand remains well-positioned to navigate the uncertainties of today's luxury environment while honoring its founder's enduring legacy.Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

Art & Culture.title: Vespa Celebrates 80 Years of an Icon With Historic New Scooters and a Roman Jubilee
Art & Culture.text: SummaryVespa is celebrating its 80th anniversary and to commemorate the milestone, Vespa has unveiled the Vespa 80th edition, available in both Primavera and GTS models, featuring a heritage-inspired Pastel Green colorwayAn exclusive "80TH ANNIVERSARY" streetwear and accessories drop accompanies the release, anchored by a new hexagonal bolt emblemThe brand will host a massive four-day celebration in Rome, the symbolic home of La Dolce Vita, from June 25 to 28, 2026On April 23, 1946, a dream on two wheels was born in post-war Italy, transforming a courageous idea for accessible mobility into a global symbol of freedom, style, and optimism. Now, exactly eighty years later, Vespa is celebrating its status as a timeless cultural icon. From inventing light urban mobility to serving as a canvas for legendary creatives like Salvador Dalí, Giorgio Armani and Christian Dior, Vespa has written indelible pages in art and social history. To honor eight decades of iconic shapes and joie de vivre, the brand is launching a stunning commemorative scooter series, a lifestyle apparel collection, and a massive upcoming jubilee in Rome.The heart of the anniversary is the new Vespa 80th, available in both the Primavera and GTS versions. Drawing directly from the Piaggio historical archives, the scooters are draped in the original Pastel Green of the very first 1946 models. This signature shade tastefully flows across the shield trim, passenger grab handle, rearview mirrors, and front suspension linkage, elegantly blending glossy and satin finishes. Deeper green tone-on-tone elements—such as the artisan-stitched saddle and rubber floorboard inserts—ground the design. The rims pay homage to the 1946 Vespa 98 with closed geometries and a diamond-finished "Est. 1946" inscription, while a commemorative "80TH" plaque sits proudly on the shield.Alongside the vehicles, Vespa has introduced a dedicated lifestyle drop that reformulates the brand's aesthetic into a renewed visual vocabulary. The urban collection is centered around a new graphic emblem: the number 80 inscribed within a hexagonal bolt, discreetly nodding to the brand's engineering roots. Fans can expect a comprehensive range of varsity jackets, cotton gabardine field jackets, functionally tailored polo shirts, and coordinated accessories. The highlight of the gear is an exclusive ABS jet helmet certified to the modern 22.06 safety standard, featuring a scratch-resistant visor and washable interiors.Moving beyond physical products, Vespa is taking the celebration to the streets of the Eternal City. From June 25 to June 28, Rome—long held in the collective imagination as the ultimate backdrop for Italian elegance—will host four days of festivities and events, promising to be the grandest celebration in the history of the legendary scooter brand.Refusing to be imprisoned by nostalgia, Vespa continues to project its timeless design into the future. The new Vespa Primavera 80th, GTS 80th, and the "80TH ANNIVERSARY" collection are available now at the VESPA THE EMPTY SPACE store in Milan, selected global showrooms, and via the official Vespa website.Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

Art & Culture.title: Hidden for Over 90 Years, Christie's Unearths an Ultra-Rare 1930 Audemars Piguet Chronograph
Art & Culture.text: SummaryChristie's Geneva will offer a highly significant circa 1930 Audemars Piguet "Coussin Tortue" single-button chronograph (No. 41,849) at its upcoming Rare Watches auction on May 11, 2026The 27.5mm platinum-cased timepiece is one of the first chronograph wristwatches ever produced by the Swiss manufacture and has remained in the family of its original owner since its purchase in 1943Offered for the very first time at auction, the historic watch carries an estimated value of CHF 200,000 to CHF 400,000 (approx. $260,000 - $510,000 USD)A true piece of horological history has been unearthed. This spring, Christie's Geneva is preparing to auction an exceptionally rare, circa 1930 Audemars Piguet "Coussin Tortue" single-button chronograph (Model No. 41,849). Widely regarded as one of the very first and rarest chronograph wristwatches ever produced by the legendary Swiss brand, the timepiece is making its auction debut after spending more than 90 years in the possession of the original owner's family. It will cross the block on May 11 at the Four Seasons Hotel des Bergues.The history of this watch represents the very genesis of Audemars Piguet's complicated wristwatch production. In 1930, the brand began producing a small batch of just six movements intended for its first-ever chronograph wristwatches. The "Coussin Tortue" offered by Christie's is one of only three watches known to have been completed from that initial batch (the first in white gold, and the subsequent two in platinum). Delivered to the retailer Veuve Louis Goering in 1937, this specific platinum example was finally purchased in 1943.The watch features a beautifully minimalist Art-Deco aesthetic. The bold, brushed platinum cushion case—crafted by the renowned Genevan casemaker Wenger—perfectly frames a stunning two-tone grey and white solid gold dial. True to the "monopusher" style of the era, the start, stop, and return-to-zero functions of the LeCoultre chronograph movement are all operated by a single press of the winding crown.Prior to consignment, the watch was sent back to its birthplace at the Audemars Piguet manufacture in the Vallée de Joux for a comprehensive and highly sympathetic restoration. Recognizing the immense historical value of the piece, the brand's master watchmakers artfully revived the 27.5mm timepiece, ensuring it retains its original 1930s character and charm.Vintage Audemars Piguet chronographs are among the most coveted timepieces in the world, largely due to their extreme scarcity. Between 1930 and 1980, the brand produced a total of just 307 chronograph wristwatches. Given its status as one of the absolute earliest examples of this lineage, the "Coussin Tortue" is expected to draw fierce bidding from global collectors when it goes up for auction, with an estimated final price between CHF 200,000 and CHF 400,000.Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast
